title: 7-Day Southern Albania Road Trip: UNESCO & Riviera Loop
excerpt: Explore Albania’s UNESCO towns and the stunning Riviera in a 7‑day road trip from Tirana Airport, with practical tips, routes and rental car advice.
intro: Landing at Tirana International Airport? Grab a rental car from AutoConnect and set off on a 7‑day southern Albania road trip that blends Ottoman heritage, dramatic mountain passes and crystal‑clear beaches—all within a manageable 550 km loop.

sections.title: Day 1–2: 7-Day Southern Albania Road Trip – Berat & Gjirokastër
sections.body: Start your journey by driving south from TIA to Berat (≈120 km). Spend the afternoon wandering the Mangalem and Gorica quarters, where the iconic Ottoman houses climb the hill beside the Osum River. After a night in a boutique guesthouse, head east to Gjirokastër (≈80 km). The town’s stone‑roofed houses and imposing fortress earned UNESCO status and provide a perfect backdrop for a leisurely stroll through the bazaar and a visit to the Skenduli House. The 7-day southern Albania road trip gives you enough time to absorb both sites without rushing.

sections.title: Day 3: Sarandë and Ksamil – Sun, Sea and History
sections.body: Leave Gjirokastër early and follow the coastal SH8 to Sarandë (≈140 km). The drive offers spectacular sea views as you descend from the Llogara Pass. In Sarandë, explore the ancient ruins of Butrint, another UNESCO gem, before heading 14 km south to Ksamil. Its turquoise coves are ideal for a relaxed afternoon of swimming or a short boat trip to the nearby islands. Return to Sarandë for dinner on the promenade, where fresh seafood and sunset hues create a memorable evening.

sections.title: Day 4: Llogara Pass to Himarë – Alpine Views to Coastal Calm
sections.body: From Sarandë, retrace the SH8 northward, climbing the Llogara Pass (1,043 m). The winding road offers panoramic vistas of the Ionian Sea and the rugged Ceraunian Mountains. After a coffee break at the summit café, descend toward the charming town of Himarë (≈35 km). Here, pebble‑streets lead to quiet beaches and the historic Himarë Castle. Spend the night in a family‑run inn, and enjoy a dinner of grilled fish while listening to local folk music—a perfect blend of mountain and sea ambience.

sections.title: Day 5‑7: Flexible Riviera Loop and Return to Tirana
sections.body: Use the remaining days to explore the Riviera at your own pace. Drive north along the SH8, stopping at the secluded beaches of Dhermi, Jale and Borsh, each offering crystal waters and dramatic cliffs. If time permits, detour inland to the ancient city of Apollonia near Fier. On day 7, begin the 150 km return to Tirana, returning the AutoConnect rental at the airport before your flight. This final leg lets you reflect on the diverse landscapes you’ve experienced, from UNESCO heritage sites to pristine coastal retreats.

tip.title: Pro Tip: Book your car early and choose a compact model
tip.body: Compact cars handle the narrow mountain roads and tight parking spots in historic towns more easily, and they consume less fuel on the 550 km loop. Reserve online with AutoConnect before you travel to secure the best rate and pick‑up time at the airport.

faq.question: Is 7 days enough for a road trip in Southern Albania?
faq.answer: Yes. The 550 km loop can be comfortably covered in seven days, allowing two nights each in Berat and Gjirokastër, a full day for Sarandë and Ksamil, and enough time to enjoy the Riviera’s beaches and mountain scenery without feeling rushed.

faq.question: What are the road conditions like along the Albanian Riviera?
faq.answer: The coastal SH8 is well‑paved but features many sharp bends and steep sections, especially around the Llogara Pass. Expect occasional narrow stretches in villages, but signage is clear and the scenery makes the drive rewarding. A reliable rental car with good brakes is advisable.

faq.question: Can I collect a rental car directly at Tirana Airport (TIA)?
faq.answer: Absolutely. AutoConnect Rental has a desk in the arrivals hall of Tirana International Airport, allowing you to pick up a vehicle as soon as you land and start your road trip without delay.
